name: Shelly Plus 1 Non-UL
summary: Gen2 in-wall 1-channel dry-contact relay, ~15-16A, AC or 12/24-48VDC powered, Wi-Fi + Bluetooth, no metering.

extra.kb_mismatch: kb_slug shelly-plus-1-ul is the UL-certified variant (SNSW-001X15UL, 15A AC); family is the Non-UL Plus 1 — ratings (15A) and UL claims in KB belong to the UL sibling
extra.neutral_note: AC supply needs N; device can instead run from 12VDC or 24-48VDC
extra.addon_warning: high voltage on add-on interface when powered

gotchas: Not UL listed — US inspectors may require the Shelly Plus 1 UL variant
No power metering — use Shelly Plus 1PM if you need watts/kWh
Inductive loads (LED drivers, fans, motors) need an RC snubber per KB
Specs come from the Plus 1 UL KB page (15A); verify the non-UL rating
Listed as unavailable; Gen3/Gen4 Shelly 1 successors exist
best_for: dry-contact switching of garage door/boiler/gate inputs or 120V lights, incl. low-voltage DC-powered installs
